sections.title: Work needing attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due,reference

sections.title: Evidence gaps
sections.sql: select cycle,code,label,observed_on,issue from v_evidence_gaps order by cycle,code

sections.title: Tie-outs
sections.sql: select cycle,name,left_value,right_value,difference,unit,tolerance,passed from v_tieouts order by cycle,name

sections.title: Current status
sections.sql: select cycle,reference,title,owner,revision,signed_revision,coalesce(is_signed,false) signed from v_reporting order by cycle,reference
